title: Evaluation Choices Shape Biomedical ML Claims: A Pediatric Pneumonia Benchmark Case Study
abstract: arXiv:2609.37848v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Biomedical machine learning papers often compress model performance into one headline number. That number can look like a property of the model even when it depends strongly on how the benchmark was evaluated. We study this problem on the widely used Kermany pediatric chest radiograph dataset using nine image classifiers and a controlled evaluation protocol. Under the same protocol, the eight pretrained backbones differ by only 0.026 AUROC. In contrast, changing whether the backbone is frozen or fine-tuned changes AUROC by 0.044 on average, and changing the decision threshold changes balanced accuracy by 0.090 on average. The official test split is also measurably different from the training pool: a partition classifier distinguishes them at AUC 0.697, rising to 0.898 for normal radiographs. Most strikingly, a classifier using only file properties, with no image anatomy, reaches 0.992 balanced accuracy within the training pool but fall

translated_title: 评估选择塑造生物医学机器学习结论：一项儿科肺炎基准的案例研究
translated_abstract: 生物医学机器学习论文常常把模型性能压缩成一个标题式的数字。即使这个数字在很大程度上取决于基准是如何被评估的，它看起来也可能像是模型本身的属性。我们在广泛使用的Kermany儿科胸部X光片数据集上，使用九个图像分类器和一套受控评估协议来研究这一问题。在同一协议下，八个预训练骨干网络之间的AUROC差异仅为0.026。相比之下，改变骨干网络是冻结还是微调平均会使AUROC变化0.044，而改变决策阈值平均会使平衡准确率变化0.090。官方测试集划分与训练数据池之间也存在可测量的差异：一个划分分类器能够以0.697的AUC区分二者，对于正常X光片该数值升至0.898。最引人注目的是，一个仅使用文件属性、完全不依赖图像解剖结构的分类器，在训练数据池内达到了0.992的平衡准确率，但……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究通过受控评估协议证明，在Kermany儿科肺炎胸片基准上，冻结/微调、决策阈值等评估选择对性能的影响远大于模型架构本身，且官方测试集与训练数据存在系统性分布差异，说明“单一标题数字”更多反映的是评估方式而非模型的真实优劣。
en_tdlr: Evaluation choices—such as freezing versus fine-tuning, decision thresholds, and train-test split design—shape benchmark performance far more than model architecture does, revealing that headline numbers in biomedical ML largely reflect how models are evaluated rather than intrinsic model quality.
